protocol.parent_rule: Up to 20 highest-fitness individuals reaching age 60; neutral ID order, balanced 100 offspring. No eligible parent permanently ends the lineage.
protocol.archive_rule: All 100 brains of the last evaluated birth cohort, including failures; maximum G archived, without extra reproduction at the horizon.
protocol.diagnostic_rule: Paired fresh standard/scarce worlds compare last-cohort archives with exact founders for every seed, including extinct lineages. Shadow tests do not resume lineages.
protocol.analysis: Exploratory; paired percentile bootstrap 20000, pointwise 95% intervals; source seed is unit, no confirmatory p-values.
protocol.limitations: Raw seasonal fitness confounds food supply, moving layouts, evolution and survivor selection. Archive tests assess changed inherited performance, not survival of the lineage or causal effects of selection alone. No static-environment control; no claim of optimal seasonal adaptation. Fixed cohort size is not an emergent population model. Viability at horizon is censored, not permanent persistence.
